entries.dad4d7c367e9c50a: It carried out the final consolidation of the strategies set out as the final year of its medium-term management plan "OX-2026 (okabe Transformation 2026)" and aims to leap to the next growth stage. The outline of its business strategy is three items: customer-centric (developing structures and implementing initiatives to solve customers' issues with the highest priority), practicing human capital management and strengthening its management base, and further promoting DX. Its policy is to provide solutions for materiality in Japan and overseas, concentrate management resources including by reviewing its business portfolio, and promote sustainability management. The target figures of the plan are matters concerning the future, so they are not transcribed here.
